Question 1
?

Which of the following is equivalent to (n+3)! for any n≥−1?

a
(n+3)⋅(n+2)
b
(n+3)⋅(n+2)!
c
(n+3)⋅(n+1)!
d
(n+2)!
e
(n+2)
Submit
